# The site's pod, in the site account: its database and its front, shared by both
# colours. dk's drop-in publishes its ports on the host's loopback and gives it the
# host-loopback network in place of edge-net
# (it resets Network= first). Partisipa's pods name edge-net the same way.
[Unit]
PartOf=notes-site@%i.target

[Pod]
PodName=notes-%i-site
Network=edge-net.network
# As Partisipa's pods: the migrate oneshot exiting must not stop the pod.
ExitPolicy=continue
